structured.approach: BE-03 asks whether the database changes this feature needs are done. I read both contracted inputs in full (feat.tasks, feat.design) to find what TSK-05 and TSK-06 in ap_aging need for storage. Then I checked the repository using the step's tool view and the ap_aging files I read: aging.py, __init__.py and CLAUDE.md. Every statement about the repository cites the tool view or the specific file that supports it. I left out claims about the repository as a whole and about the branch, because no citable source supports them. The design and the repository agree that the feature has no storage and needs no migration. So the output records that no database change is required, that none is pending, and when this check should be run again.

claims.text: The design lists 'Storage, database, schema migration' as out of scope; the data in scope is in-memory records, delay history, risk map, overdue rows and CT-1 JSON.
Design decision DD-1 adds no new repository, service, runtime, library or storage, and NF-10 requires every new function to be pure and in-memory with no I/O.
The Backend tasks TSK-05 and TSK-06 change only src/ap_aging/aging.py, src/ap_aging/__init__.py and tests/test_overdue.py; no schema or migration file is in their budget.
ap_aging has no database; no migrations exist or are required.
aging.py imports only datetime.date, decimal.Decimal and typing (Dict, Iterable), and aging_buckets works on an in-memory iterable of invoice dicts passed in by the caller.
The ap_aging package __init__.py imports only aging_buckets from .aging and exports it.
ap_aging is Python 3.9 using the standard library.
Adding a transport between ap_aging and ap_portal, or any storage or network call from the libraries, would reopen DES-01 and so also this database check.
The paid_date key is added in memory by the Data Engineering lane in transform.to_model (TSK-01), not by a database change.

structured.summary: I rewrote `task.db_changes.md` for FEAT-ZD-48600 (BE-03), fixing all three points the judge raised: this feature needs no database changes, so there is nothing to complete. The design puts storage, databases and schema migrations out of scope (A1, DD-1, NF-10). The tool view confirms ap_aging has no database and no migrations, and aging.py imports only date, Decimal and typing. No DBA or infra-team action is needed for TSK-05 or TSK-06. The output also lists when to re-run this check. I removed three statements: the file listing, the repository-wide search result and the branch name. The judge found the cited sources did not support them; each now cites only the tool view or the file that supports it. There are no blocking questions.
